mechanic.title: Reality_Anchor
mechanic.description: Reality Anchor is a Sokoban-like prototype where movable two-cell anchors split the board into rule regions. A P/L anchor selects push or pull behavior by the player's side at input time. A B/S anchor globally normalizes boxes into sticky blocks on the sticky side and back into boxes on the box side.

effect.result: player pushes the adjacent movable object; force may propagate forward
player moves into an empty front cell and pulls the adjacent object behind them
box side cells become crates; sticky side cells become sticky cells
orthogonally adjacent sticky cells form one rigid block
all targets covered by crates, sticky blocks, or anchor cells wins

win.description: After movement, box/sticky normalization, and sticky merging settle, every target must be covered by a crate, sticky block cell, or anchor cell. The player standing on a target does not count.

reachability_macro.notes: Do not enable until Reality Anchor rule summaries prove the preconditions.

levels.title: Fixed P/L push-pull v1
levels.design_notes: Curriculum slot 2 fixed P/L teaching witness. P/L is sealed in a wall pocket: complete reachable event scan reports no anchor shift or material events. The top mini-task requires push_object; the bottom mini-task requires pull_object after the player stands on the lower goal. Complete event probes prove every win path requires both push and pull. Goal-deletion counterfactuals show the upper target is the push witness and the lower target is the pull witness. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_claim / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none. Caveat: this is a two-witness teaching level, not a depth-bearing puzzle; the lower crate has non-winning push affordances, but every win still requires pull. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected the lower affordance shape for this slot: players can first try pushing from the left and receive no feedback before learning pull. Superseded by v2.

levels.title: Fixed P/L handoff v1
levels.design_notes: Curriculum slot 3 fixed P/L application. A single crate and single target form a push-to-pull handoff: the crate must first be pushed into alignment above the goal, then pulled from the pull side to cover it. Complete event probes prove every win path requires both push_object and pull_object; because the layout has exactly one crate, the returned push/pull events are the same crate. Complete reachable scan reports no anchor shift or material events. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_claim / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none. Caveat: intentionally short early application witness, not a challenge-depth puzzle; wall-pocketed P/L is functional rather than aesthetic centerpiece. 2026-07-04 human playtest found two effective moves too small and asked for a slightly larger same-crate push/pull familiarization exercise. Superseded by v2.

levels.title: Long-edge P/L relay v1
levels.design_notes: Curriculum slot 5 P/L long-edge relay candidate. The shortest witness first pulls the horizontal P/L anchor right from its L side, then loops to its P side and pushes the same anchor right again so the anchor covers the upper target. The lower row then requires ordinary crate push on the left target and ordinary crate pull on the right target. Complete analysis reports a 19-step shortest solution over 243 reachable states. Instance-level event probe proves every win requires pull_object:push_pull_anchor, push_object:push_pull_anchor, push_object:crate#1, and pull_object:crate#2. Direction-aware probe further proves every win requires the anchor pull and anchor push to move the P/L anchor horizontally right, i.e. along the long edge in the same direction. Goal-prune counterfactuals keep all three targets: deleting the top target bypasses the P/L pull/push, deleting the left lower target bypasses crate push, and deleting the right lower target bypasses crate pull. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_with_caveats / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none. Caveat: vertical P/L movement is reachable in non-winning exploration, so this candidate should be described as requiring horizontal same-direction long-edge P/L pull and push in winning paths, not as fully forbidding vertical P/L interactions. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected this version for weak causal coupling: the top P/L task, left push, and right pull read as a stitched checklist, especially the right pull. Superseded by v2.

levels.title: Long-edge P/L relay v2
levels.design_notes: Human-feedback revision of L05 v1. The ordinary crate pull is no longer a right-side add-on target: the middle crate must be pulled right to open the lower loop that reaches the left side. The player then pushes the lower crate onto its target and returns to the P side to push the same horizontal P/L anchor right onto the top target. Complete graph analysis reports a 17-step witness over 4331 reachable states. Direction-aware event probe is complete with no winning bypass missing anchor_pull_right, anchor_push_right, crate_pull, or crate_push. Anchor shift count probe is complete with no win below two P/L shifts. Goal-prune counterfactuals retain all three targets: deleting the top target bypasses anchor_push_right, deleting the middle target bypasses ordinary crate push/pull responsibilities, and deleting the lower target bypasses crate_push. This version intentionally keeps the middle target to prevent the pulled gate crate from replacing the lower push crate. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected the opening fixed P/L pull: the P/L timing should be an active middle-step inference, not first-step execution or final-only tag. Superseded by v3.

levels.title: Long-edge P/L relay v3
levels.design_notes: Human-feedback revision of L05 v2. The P/L anchor is no longer touched on the first move: the opening ordinary crate pull sequence creates a space debt that lets the player reach the top P/L area. The P/L right pull occurs in the middle of the route, the lower crate is then pulled into a temporary position, and the P/L right push changes the boundary before the lower crate is finally pushed onto its target. Complete graph analysis reports a 34-step shortest solution over 1203 reachable states. Direction-aware event probe is complete with no winning bypass missing anchor_pull_right, anchor_push_right, crate_pull, or crate_push; anchor shift count probe is complete with no win below two P/L shifts. Caveat: this version deliberately fixes the P/L timing issue but is longer and more crate-pull heavy, so critic should attack route length and whether the early crate manipulation reads as setup rather than padding. Independent review_3 evidence reviewer returned supports_with_caveats / required_action:none, but puzzle critic returned revise_required / structural_revision: the 34-step route and five early crate#1 pulls read too much like route tax before the P/L insight. Removed from playable pending a deeper v4 redesign.

levels.title: Multi-axis P/L relay v1
levels.design_notes: Curriculum slot 6 multi-axis P/L application candidate. The shortest witness uses three required P/L direction-action groups: vertical down pull, horizontal right pull, and horizontal right push. It also requires ordinary left-crate push and right-crate pull. Complete analysis reports a 31-step shortest solution over 9028 reachable states. Instance-level event probe proves all wins require anchor pull, anchor push, push_object:crate#1, and pull_object:crate#2. Direction-aware probe proves all wins require anchor_pull_down, anchor_pull_right, anchor_push_right, left_crate_push, and right_crate_pull. Goal-prune counterfactuals keep all four targets: deleting either upper target releases a missing-anchor_push_right win, while deleting either lower target lowers cost and releases a missing right_crate_pull win. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_with_caveats / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none. Caveats: the left crate is pushed onto its target, pulled back to reopen access, and pushed back later, which may feel like functional rework; the visual skeleton is close to L05, though this candidate adds vertical P/L routing and upper double target pressure. Do not claim unique ordering or that only the three required P/L shift directions are reachable. 2026-07-04 human playtest praised the left-side push/pull-back/re-push contradiction but rejected the right side as stitched-on extra space. Superseded by v2.

levels.title: Vacate bind return v1
levels.design_notes: review_1 提交待玩候选。该关使用 mechanism_lab/lexicon.md 的 P/L 横向把手墙格门、 B/S 绑定债、B/S 解绑定债和刚体黏块回返谱系组合成状态责任反转：top_goal [3,1] 必须先覆盖、再腾空、最终回填。完整 core7 probe 证明所有胜路都包含 P/L shift、B/S shift、pull、box_to_sticky、sticky_to_box、sticky rigid movement 与 sticky_merge；target-vacate probe 证明所有胜路都必须让 [3,1] 经历 covered -> uncovered -> covered。Evidence reviewer 与 puzzle critic 均为 proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action none。只声明 state-level responsibility reversal，不声明唯一输入序列或对象身份级必要性。2026-07-06 human playtest 要求确认右上黏块和上方空格的作用；反事实显示最右活动列可裁掉且保持核心证据， 因此 v1 被 v2 取代。直接删除顶行把手并左移起点、或把把手随起点左移的局部版本均完整无解。

levels.title: Vacate bind return v2
levels.design_notes: Human-feedback revision of RA_LEX_2026_07_06_VACATE_BIND_RETURN_v1. The far-right activity column, containing the right-upper sticky and the space above it, is removed. Complete analysis keeps the same 27-step witness while reducing the graph from 691 reachable states / 1517 legal transitions to 449 / 975. Complete core7 probe still proves all wins require P/L shift, B/S shift, pull, box_to_sticky, sticky_to_box, sticky rigid movement, and sticky_merge. Target-vacate probe still proves top_goal [3,1] must go covered -> uncovered -> covered before win. Local variants that also moved the start left by deleting or shifting the top-row sticky handle were complete no-win graphs, so this v2 performs the safe structural deletion without overclaiming that the start can be locally left-shifted. Superseded by v3, which keeps this trimmed structure but moves the start within the same initial SCC to remove the first-step object-push affordance.

levels.title: Vacate bind return v3 opening comfort
levels.design_notes: Opening comfort revision of v2. Start enumeration over the trimmed v2 layout found that the human-suggested left-shift starts either produced complete no-win graphs or made the first commitment immediate. This v3 keeps the same trimmed structure and moves the player from [6,1] to [6,3], a position in the same 5-state initial SCC. Complete explain-layout still reports 449 reachable states / 975 legal transitions, a 27-step shortest solution, initial SCC states=5, out=2, winOut=1, deadOut=1, and opening commitments 2 / viable 1 / dead 1. The returned solution's first irreversible commitment remains after two reversible walk steps, but the first-step legal actions are now only walks, avoiding the v2 start's immediate object-push affordance. Complete core7 probe still proves all wins require P/L shift, B/S shift, pull, box_to_sticky, sticky_to_box, sticky rigid movement, and sticky_merge. Target-vacate probe still proves top_goal [3,1] must go covered -> uncovered -> covered before win.

levels.title: PL vacate recover v2
levels.design_notes: Fresh lexicon-composition candidate built from P/L boundary handoff and P/L pull-extraction vocabulary. v1 was rejected by puzzle critic as clean 2 because the two endpoint pulls were mostly independent. v2 adds a shared state debt: the lower target is first covered by the chain push, then must be vacated by pulling that crate upward onto the upper target, and finally recovered by pulling the remaining crate into the lower target. Complete graph analysis reports cost 10, 20 reachable states / 33 legal transitions / 1 winning state. Core event probe is complete/no bypass for push, force_chain, and pull; pull-count probe is complete/no bypass below two pull events; target-vacate probe is complete/no bypass for lower target [5,3] covered -> uncovered -> covered; fixed P/L scan is complete with no anchor_boundary_shift:push_pull reachable hits. Independent evidence review returned proposal_ready / required_action:none. Independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none and allows playable submission only as strong aesthetic 3 / low difficulty 3, not a 4 claim. Evidence: prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/candidate_packet_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_review2.zh.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/evidence_review_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_review_2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/puzzle_critic_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_review_2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/layout_analysis_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/event_probe_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_core.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/event_count_probe_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_pull_count_pull_object_min2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/target_vacate_probe_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_lower_target_vacate.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/fixed_anchor_probe_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PL_VACATE_RECOVER_v2_pl_fixed_scan.md.

levels.title: Ratchet split tooth v1
levels.design_notes: review_1 提交候选。基于 lexicon 的 P/L 长轴墙廊 / L 端余量棘轮、 固定 B/S 断桥 sticky split 端点目标袋、以及刚体黏块 + 墙齿目标口 组合而成。玩家需要把 P/L 从直接盖目标的 anchor 重读为长轴推杆： 先下移和侧移 P/L，再连续 force-chain 左推 C 形 sticky；第二次左推 穿过固定 B/S，触发 sticky_to_box:n3 与 sticky_split:n1，切出独立上端点； 最后用 P/L 从下方 force-chain 把该端点推入上方 G## 墙齿目标。完整图 359 states / 919 transitions / 2 winning states；core5 probe complete 且无 缺失 P/L shift、force_chain、sticky_to_box、sticky_split、sticky rigid movement 的胜利旁路；count probes complete 且证明所有胜解至少需要 5 次 anchor_boundary_shift:push_pull 与 3 次 move_sticky_rigid。SCC 读法为初始 SCC 21 states、out=4、winOut=2、deadOut=2，forced commitment / viable / optimal prefix 均为 0，中段有 2/4 handoff scriptiness。独立 evidence reviewer 为 supports_with_caveats / required_action none；puzzle critic 为 supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action none，校准为审美强 3、难度 3+，但不支持稳定 4 档宣传。Evidence packet: prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/candidate_packet_RA_LEX_2026_07_07_RATCHET_SPLIT_TOOTH_v1_review1.zh.md Review artifacts: prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/evidence_review_RA_LEX_2026_07_07_RATCHET_SPLIT_TOOTH_v1_review_1.md and prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/puzzle_critic_RA_LEX_2026_07_07_RATCHET_SPLIT_TOOTH_v1_review_1.md.

levels.title: Fixed B/S sticky rigid v1
levels.design_notes: Curriculum slot 7 fixed B/S sticky rigid intro witness. There is no P/L anchor; B/S is fixed in a wall pocket and only defines the sticky side. The player pushes the upper cell of a vertical sticky pair twice; the lower cell moves as part of the same rigid body and covers the only target. Complete analysis reports a 2-step shortest solution over 16 reachable states. Core event probe proves all wins require push_object:sticky#1 and move_sticky_rigid. Reachable scan reports no P/L shift, no B/S shift, and no material conversion, split, or merge. A concrete ordinary-box analog is complete unsolved, so in this layout the target cannot be covered without sticky rigid movement. Goal-prune is skipped because this is a single-target level. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_with_caveats / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none. Caveat: this is a right-right tiny mechanism witness rather than a puzzle; the box analog evidence applies to the listed analog, not every possible box-only redesign. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected this version because the two sticky cells start already joined, so it does not witness sticky joining. Superseded by v2.

levels.title: Fixed B/S join v1
levels.design_notes: Curriculum slot 8 fixed B/S joining candidate. There is no P/L anchor; B/S is fixed and defines a horizontal box/sticky split. The first move pushes a crate from box side into sticky side, converting it with box_to_sticky and immediately joining it to the lower sticky cell. The new upper sticky cell then becomes the only usable handle for pushing the merged rigid body right until the lower cell covers the target. Complete analysis reports a 5-step shortest solution over 186 reachable states. Complete event probe proves all wins require box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, and move_sticky_rigid; reachable scan reports no P/L shift, no B/S shift, no sticky_to_box, and no split. Goal-prune is skipped because this is a single-target level. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_claim / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned proposal_ready_with_caveats / required_action:none. Caveat: this is a short mechanism witness whose conversion and join happen on the first move; it should be treated as a fixed-B/S joining demonstration, not a high-density puzzle. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected the start placement because the opening down move directly enters the correct conversion. Superseded by v2.

levels.title: Fixed B/S join v2
levels.design_notes: Human-feedback revision of L08 v1. The mechanism skeleton is unchanged, but the player starts in the right-middle area instead of directly above the crate, so the opening is no longer a one-step straight push into conversion. The shortest solution walks back to the conversion entrance, pushes the crate from box side into sticky side to trigger box_to_sticky and sticky_merge, then uses the new sticky handle to push the merged rigid body onto the target. Complete graph analysis reports a 9-step shortest solution over 186 reachable states. Fixed-anchor strong-material probe proves every win requires box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, and move_sticky_rigid; reachable scan reports no P/L shift, no B/S shift, no sticky_to_box, and no split. Caveat: this is still a compact fixed-B/S join demonstration, not a high-density challenge. Independent review_2 evidence reviewer returned supports_claim / required_action:none; puzzle critic returned supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none. 2026-07-04 human playtest asked to remove the unused far-right empty column; superseded by v3.

levels.title: Movable B/S cutback v1
levels.design_notes: 第十关槽位候选：无 P/L，可推动 B/S。初始归一化后，上方 C 与下方 M 都在 S 侧，形成被下方墙锁住的竖向黏块。玩家必须先 右推 B/S 一格，移动材料边界并触发 sticky_to_box，将竖向黏块 切成两个普通箱子；随后把上方箱子推回 S 侧，触发 box_to_sticky， 再推动回黏后的黏块覆盖目标。完整分析给出 5 步最短解和 47 个 reachable states 的 complete graph。core event probe complete/no bypass，证明所有胜路都需要 anchor_boundary_shift:box_sticky、 sticky_to_box、box_to_sticky、move_sticky_rigid 和 push_object:crate#1；reachable scan 证明无 P/L 命中。单目标， 因此无效 goal prune skipped。独立 evidence reviewer 返回 supports_claim / required_action:none；独立 puzzle critic 返回 supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none。caveat 是 第一步即推 B/S、关卡短且脚本化；它是可动 B/S 切割回黏 witness， 不应包装成充分体现时机选择的复杂应用题。 2026-07-05 human feedback rejected it for the L10 slot: the player has no meaningful pre-anchor work, pushes B/S immediately as the only obvious action, and the anchor is not used again after the opening cut. Removed from playable and superseded by a timed join/cut revision.

levels.title: Movable B/S timed join-cut v2
levels.design_notes: Human-feedback revision of L10 v1. This candidate keeps the slot constraints: no P/L, movable B/S, and real box/sticky conversion. Unlike v1, the player cannot win by opening with B/S movement: an order probe is complete with no win where B/S shifts before any sticky_merge. The returned 13-step witness first pushes a crate into S side to trigger box_to_sticky and sticky_merge, then uses B/S twice: once to move into the upper channel and once to trigger sticky_to_box, cutting a sticky cell back into a crate. The cut crate is then pushed down, and the remaining sticky pair is moved onto the target. Complete analysis reports 221 reachable states; the core event probe proves all wins require B/S shift, box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, sticky_to_box, sticky rigid movement, and crate push. A count probe proves all wins require at least two B/S shifts; reachable scan reports no P/L hit. Single target, so invalid goal prune is skipped. Independent evidence reviewer returned supports_claim / required_action:none; independent puzzle critic returned supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none. Caveat: the win chain remains strongly forced and close to the L11 boundary, but it directly fixes the rejected v1 issue that B/S was only an opening button. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected this version for large redundant space, a redundant left crate, and redundant upper-right space. Superseded by v3.

levels.title: Pull cut anchor handoff v2
levels.design_notes: Fresh lexicon-composition candidate based on `mechanism_lab/lexicon.md` only; `mechanism_lab/runs/` was not read. The candidate combines fixed B/S cut, fixed P/L pull-region handoff, and final B/S force-chain. v1 had an extra lower target, but Reality Anchor goal-prune evidence showed that target was side-effect coverage, so v2 keeps only the upper target. Complete graph and event probes show every win requires pull_object, B/S anchor shift, sticky_to_box, sticky rigid movement, and force_chain; fixed-anchor scan shows P/L anchor shift is not reachable. Review_1 evidence review required downgrading object-role and exact-order overclaims; review_2 packet now treats the cut-output handoff as returned-trace design reading, not all-solution per-object proof. Independent evidence review_2 and puzzle critic review_2 both returned required_action:none. Accepted score posture: difficulty 3 and strong aesthetic 3 floor; do not pre-claim 4. Evidence: prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/candidate_packet_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PULL_CUT_ANCHOR_HANDOFF_v2_review2.zh.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/evidence_review_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PULL_CUT_ANCHOR_HANDOFF_v2_review_2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/puzzle_critic_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PULL_CUT_ANCHOR_HANDOFF_v2_review_2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/redundant_element_prune_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_PULL_CUT_ANCHOR_HANDOFF_v2.zh.md. 2026-07-08 human playtest flagged the rightmost exterior wall column as redundant and explicitly approved direct archive after deleting it. Superseded by v3_right_wall_trim.

levels.title: Movable B/S relay-cut v1
levels.design_notes: 第十一关槽位候选：无 P/L，可推动 B/S，比 L10 v2 更偏 relay-cut 的双区域结构。运行时初始归一化后，上方 M 显示为 C。返回 10 步 witness 先推动下方黏块并触发 sticky_merge，再移动 B/S 左移触发 box_to_sticky，随后推动上方黏块触发 sticky_to_box，最后第二次移动 B/S 覆盖下方目标。完整分析给出 429 reachable states 的 complete graph。core_no_crate probe 证明所有胜路都需要 B/S shift、 box_to_sticky、sticky_merge、sticky_to_box 和 move_sticky_rigid； order probe 证明不存在 B/S 在 sticky_merge 前移动的胜路；count probe 证明所有胜路至少两次 B/S shift；reachable scan 证明无 P/L 命中。goal-prune 反事实保留两个目标：删上目标会释放缺 sticky_merge / sticky_to_box 的胜路，删下目标会释放缺 box_to_sticky / sticky_merge / move_sticky_rigid 的短路。独立 evidence reviewer 返回 supports_claim / required_action:none；独立 puzzle critic 返回 supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none。 Caveat：ordinary crate push 不是全胜路必要，不应声称切出的普通箱 必须被推动；核心主张是拼接、切割、B/S 双位移和黏块移动不可省。 2026-07-05 human feedback rejected it: the sticky merge / material conversion chain is only an event witness. The crate that becomes sticky is left in the corner and never later consumed as a meaningful changed object, so the player-facing solution is just pushing a box and sticky material onto two targets. This does not satisfy the required standard that conversions must produce later-used reachability, structural separation, or object-role change.

levels.title: Movable B/S applied cut v1
levels.design_notes: 第十一关槽位候选：无 P/L，可推动 B/S，并把拼接与切割放进同一条 后续被消费的因果链。运行时初始归一化后，左侧 M 显示为 C。返回 15 步 witness 先将 C 推入 S 侧，触发 box_to_sticky 与 sticky_merge 形成三连；之后才两次推动 B/S，其中第二次触发 sticky_to_box，将左端 切回普通箱。切出的普通箱随后继续下推两次覆盖下目标，剩余二连黏块 再作为刚体移动覆盖上目标。Complete graph 为 284 states / 680 transitions，最短 15。核心 probe complete/no bypass；count probes 证明所有胜路至少两次 B/S 位移、至少三次 crate#1 推动、至少两次 sticky rigid movement；order probe 证明不存在 B/S 位移早于 sticky_merge 的胜路。Goal-prune 反事实保留两个目标：删上目标会释放缺 sticky_rigid 的胜路，删下目标会释放少于三次 crate#1 推动的胜路。 有效 repo-local skill review：evidence reviewer 返回 supports_with_caveats / required_action:none；puzzle critic 返回 supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none。Caveat：不声明唯一解、 实例级全路径对象身份、全路径精确事件顺序，也不声明新黏块作为三连刚体 被后续消费；本关定位为 L11 常规应用关，而非高难亮点关。 2026-07-05 human feedback rejected it: this version violates the fresh_required lineage policy by functioning as a copied/variant structure of an existing level, and the player-facing sticky/box changes still do not produce a satisfying independent structural insight. Removed from playable and to be redesigned from a fresh causal family.

levels.title: Fixed parallel dual join v1
levels.design_notes: 第十二关槽位候选：两个竖向、互相平行、墙隔离的固定锚点。B/S 提供材料边界，P/L 提供 pull 区。返回 5 步 witness 先下推 C， 触发 box_to_sticky 与 sticky_merge，制造竖向二连黏块；随后在 P/L pull 区连续右拉这个二连结构，使两个目标同时被同一结构覆盖。 Complete graph 为 887 states / 2256 transitions，最短 5。Core probe 证明所有胜路都需要 pull_object、box_to_sticky、sticky_merge 与 move_sticky_rigid。Fixed P/L probe 证明 fixed_push_pull_effect complete/no bypass，且 reachable scan 无 anchor_boundary_shift:push_pull； fixed B/S probe 证明 fixed_box_sticky_effect、box_to_sticky、sticky_merge 与 sticky_rigid_move complete/no bypass，且 reachable scan 无 anchor_boundary_shift:box_sticky。Goal-prune 反事实保留两个目标：删上目标 释放缺 box_to_sticky / sticky_merge 的胜路，删下目标释放缺 pull / sticky_merge / sticky_rigid 的胜路。有效 repo-local skill review： evidence reviewer 返回 supports_claim / required_action:none；puzzle critic 返回 supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none。Caveat：这是 固定平行双锚点过渡应用关，5 步较短，不应包装成高密度双锚挑战。 2026-07-05 human feedback rejected it: the level is too simple and has no meaningful world-interleaving insight. Sticky material is effectively used as a step-saving handle rather than for unique reachability or separation, and the P/L anchor does not create a meaningful player-side constraint. Removed from playable and to be redesigned.

levels.title: Fixed orthogonal pull-convert v2
levels.design_notes: 第十三关槽位候选：P/L 是竖向固定锚点，B/S 是横向固定锚点， 两者正交且都墙隔离。返回 5 步 witness 中，玩家绕到 C 右侧， 第一次向右移动在 P/L pull 区拉 C，同时让 C 跨过 B/S 材料边界， 触发 box_to_sticky 与 sticky_merge，生成竖向二连黏块；第二次 向右 pull 消费该二连结构并覆盖两个目标。Complete graph 为 1239 states / 3506 transitions，最短 5。Fixed B/S probe 证明 fixed_box_sticky_effect、pull_event、box_to_sticky、sticky_merge 与 sticky_rigid_move 均 complete/no bypass，且 reachable scan 无 anchor_boundary_shift:box_sticky。Fixed P/L probe 证明 fixed_push_pull_effect 与 material_normalization complete/no bypass，且 reachable scan 无 anchor_boundary_shift:push_pull。Goal-prune 反事实保留两个目标：删上目标 释放 2 步、缺 fixed_box_sticky_effect / box_to_sticky / sticky_merge 的胜路；删下目标也释放缺这些组的胜路。有效 repo-local skill review： evidence reviewer 返回 supports_claim / required_action:none；puzzle critic 返回 supports_with_noncore_caveats / required_action:none。Caveat：这是 固定正交双锚点微应用，5 步较短；与 L12 都使用二连黏块覆盖双目标， 差异在于本关的第一次 P/L pull 同时触发 B/S 转化/合并。 2026-07-05 human feedback rejected it: the level is too simple and too close to L12, with no real insight into the interleaved worlds. Triggering pull and material conversion in analysis is not enough; the player can read it as a trivial pull sequence rather than a meaningful dual-anchor structure. Removed from playable and to be redesigned.

levels.title: Fixed B/S sticky handle v1
levels.design_notes: review_1 fixed-anchor transition candidate. B/S is deliberately isolated in a wall chamber so players can focus on moving P/L while still observing the fixed material boundary. The crate must first be brought across the fixed B/S split to become sticky, merge with the waiting sticky cell, and then move as a sticky rigid body; simply changing material without using the changed movement would not solve the level. The all-solution probe for the submitted candidate found no win that avoids the movable P/L shift, box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, and sticky rigid movement events. 2026-07-04 user review rejected this as a qualified archive candidate: the sticky structure is not functionally necessary because replacing the sticky cells with ordinary boxes would only add pushes rather than invalidate the solve.

levels.title: Fixed P/L vertical pair v2
levels.design_notes: review_1 fixed-anchor transition candidate. P/L is isolated in a wall chamber while B/S remains movable, making this a midpoint lesson before both anchors must be repositioned together. The narrow shaft lets the player pull B/S to alter the lower material boundary without letting the anchor itself cover the vertical targets. The intended route depends on the lower object changing material, merging, and then being pulled as a sticky rigid body; the submitted all-solution probe found no win that avoids B/S anchor movement, box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, and sticky rigid movement. 2026-07-04 user review rejected this as a qualified archive candidate: the sticky structure is not functionally necessary because replacing the sticky cells with ordinary boxes would only add pushes rather than invalidate the solve.

levels.title: Dual lockstep v2
levels.design_notes: review_2 提交候选。水平 P/L 与水平 B/S 形成横向 lockstep：B/S 先制造箱/黏 材料债务，中段 box_to_sticky + sticky_merge 成为全胜路必要事件，随后 B/S 逐格右移把合并材料转成右侧收束链；pull crate 与最终 pull P/L 完成目标覆盖。 完整事件组探针证明所有胜路都包含两类 anchor shift、pull、material normalization、sticky_merge 与 sticky rigid movement；不声明唯一路线或对象身份必要性。 2026-07-04 human playtest marked the lower-left material cell as unclear. A wall replacement probe showed the same 19-step solve remains valid, so v2 is superseded rather than archived.

levels.title: Dual lockstep v3
levels.design_notes: Minimal response to the 2026-07-04 human playtest on DUAL_LOCKSTEP_v2. The lower-left material cell was replaced by a wall after a wall probe confirmed it was not needed: the same 19-step solution remains solvable and graph-complete. This keeps the central B/S lockstep and material chain while removing the misleading unused ballast. v3 is a temporary revision candidate, not yet human-accepted. 2026-07-04 follow-up playtest questioned the lower-right M and empty cells; counterfactuals showed the lower-right M and extra lower spaces were unnecessary, so v3 is replaced by v4.

levels.title: Fixed B/S sidecar ferry v2
levels.design_notes: review_2 合格待玩候选，proposal_ready_with_caveats。两个锚点同关，其中 B/S 被墙腔固定，只作为稳定材料边界；P/L 可移动但只需右推一次，用于把目标下方 操作点切到 push side。C 从 B 列左推到 S 列时 box_to_sticky，并与侧挂 M sticky_merge；左格下方是墙、上方目标室封死，普通箱没有自己的向上施力面， 只能由右侧把手格作为 sticky 刚体携带上移。固定锚点探针完整证明所有胜路都 包含 P/L shift、box_to_sticky、sticky_merge 与 sticky rigid movement，且 B/S 在可达图中无位移。初始普通箱替代版与 post-merge 普通箱替代版均完整无解， 用于回应“黏性只是多推几步省操作”的失败模式。非核心 caveat：P/L 一次右推 更像区域切换提示而非独立 aha；B/S 仍可能被读成区域标签；定位为中期过渡关。 2026-07-04 human playtest allowed keeping it as teaching / mechanism introduction, but noted redundant space. v2 is replaced by the compact v3.

levels.title: Fixed B/S sidecar ferry v3
levels.design_notes: Compact feedback revision of v2 for early/mid transition play. B/S remains fixed in a wall chamber and provides the material boundary; P/L shifts right once to let the player reach the upper work face. C is pushed left through the fixed B/S boundary, triggers box_to_sticky, sticky_merge with the side M, and then the merged sticky pair is moved upward onto the two targets. Initial ordinary-box and postmerge ordinary-box analogs are complete unsolved, so the sticky conversion is structural rather than just a shorter route. Fixed-anchor probe is complete: all wins require P/L shift, fixed B/S material effect, box_to_sticky, sticky_merge and sticky rigid movement; no reachable B/S shift. 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected the structure for this batch: the movable P/L mainly gets moved out of the way at the start, after which the puzzle degenerates into push-world operation. It is removed from playable and kept only as a redesign note, not as an archive candidate.

levels.title: Fixed P/L downpull sidecar v2
levels.design_notes: review_1 合格待玩候选，proposal_ready_with_caveats。两个锚点同关，其中 P/L 被墙腔固定，不可移动，但全局提供上层 push / 下层 pull 的操作语法；B/S 可移动一次，作为材料窗口。玩家先右推 B/S，使 x=5 进入 sticky side，再把 左侧 M 存到左目标、从 pull side 把 C 拉进 sticky side 触发 box_to_sticky， 随后拉回 M 与新黏块 sticky_merge，形成横向二连 sticky 刚体。右目标的上/右/下 施力面被墙形封住，普通箱不能独立补位，只能由左把手格携带右格下落覆盖双目标。 固定锚点探针完整证明所有胜路都包含 B/S shift、pull、box_to_sticky、 sticky_merge 与 sticky rigid movement，且 P/L 在可达图中无位移。初始普通箱 替代版与 post-merge 普通箱替代版均完整无解，用于回应“黏性只是多推几步省操作” 的失败模式。非核心 caveat：B/S 是一次性材料窗口、固定 P/L 是过渡语法，解很短； 定位为中期 compact transition，不声明高难或分数化质量。 2026-07-04 human playtest noted redundant right-side space while keeping the lower structure as interesting early/mid mechanism introduction. v2 is replaced by compact v3.

levels.title: Fixed P/L split lift v5
levels.design_notes: review_1 合格待玩候选，proposal_ready_with_caveats。两个锚点同关，其中 P/L 被墙腔固定，不可移动，但全局提供左侧目标列的 pull 操作语法；B/S 在右侧竖井中 可下推一次，作为材料边界设置。玩家先下推 B/S，再走到目标列拉动竖向黏性二连块： 第一次 pull 通过 sticky rigid movement 把两格一起上提，同时上格跨到 B side 触发 sticky_to_box，和下方黏块分离；第二次 pull 只移动上箱到上目标，下黏块留在 下目标。普通双箱替代版完整无解，说明这里的黏性不是省步数，而是先共同抬升、 再材料拆分的必要结构。固定锚点探针完整证明所有胜路都包含 B/S shift、pull、 material normalization，且 P/L 在可达图中无位移；自定义核心事件探针完整证明所有 胜路都包含 B/S shift、pull、sticky_to_box 与 sticky rigid movement。非核心 caveat：解短且走廊化，B/S 是一次性设置，定位为中期 witness-like transition， 不声明高难或分数化质量。 2026-07-04 human playtest noted redundant right-side space while otherwise calling it an interesting small early level. v5 is replaced by compact v6.

levels.title: Sticky shadow handle v2
levels.design_notes: review_1 曾被工具流程标为 proposal_ready_with_caveats。2026-07-04 人测反馈将其 打回：返回解虽然使用了 box_to_sticky、sticky_merge 和 sticky 刚体移动，但在更强 判据下，黏性结构没有功能必要性。若把黏块换成普通箱，似乎只是增加推数，而不是 让解法失效，因此这里的材料变化属于执行压缩 / 省走路，不是必要的黏箱结构转化。 已从临时 playable 队列移除，不具备归档资格。

levels.title: Fixed P/L shadow pull v2
levels.design_notes: review_1 曾被工具流程标为 proposal_ready_with_caveats。2026-07-04 人测反馈将其 打回：返回解虽然使用了固定 P/L 的 pull-side 行为、box_to_sticky、sticky_merge 和 sticky 刚体移动，但在更强判据下，黏性结构没有功能必要性。若把黏块换成普通箱， 似乎只是增加推数，而不是让解法失效，因此这里的材料变化属于执行压缩 / 省走路， 不是必要的黏箱结构转化。已从临时 playable 队列移除，不具备归档资格。

levels.title: Phase ferry v8
levels.design_notes: review_2 提交候选。紧凑双锚 two-stage phase shuttle：P/L 与 B/S 均为水平锚点， 左目标需要先 sticky_merge 再 sticky_to_box 转箱覆盖，右上目标需要中段 pull/推移两个锚点后把 sticky 刚体送达。v8 将 v6 的底部 movable ballast C 改为诚实墙约束，并将 claim 降级为双阶段相位 shuttle，不声明同一对象身份链。 完整事件组探针证明所有胜路都包含两类 anchor shift、pull、material normalization、sticky_merge 与 sticky rigid movement；不声明唯一路线或对象身份必要性。 2026-07-04 human playtest marked the sticky-material necessity as unclear: the sticky merge may be only incidental adjacency rather than a non-substitutable sticky structure or a sticky-only ban on alternate solves. Kept as needs_revision, not archive-ready.

levels.title: Soft handoff v2
levels.design_notes: review_1 提交候选。较低难度的双锚 soft handoff：B/S 先被拉上来，带动左侧 crate 跨过材料边界转成 sticky，并通过短横向拉动覆盖上目标；P/L 最后作为 下目标覆盖锚收束。完整事件组探针证明所有胜路都包含 P/L anchor shift、 B/S anchor shift、pull、material normalization 与 sticky rigid movement。 不声明唯一解、对象实例级必要性或 sticky_merge。

levels.title: Overshoot cut dual pocket v2
levels.design_notes: Fresh lexicon-composition candidate revised from the rejected v1 tail-target draft. The player pushes two crates across the fixed B/S boundary, first seeing C+M and then deliberately overshooting into a merged MM bar. Returning the bar left across the fixed boundary cuts it into C+M; the two halves are then allocated upward into adjacent top pockets. Complete event probes show every win requires box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, sticky_to_box, sticky rigid movement, and force_chain. Deleting either top target collapses the design into ordinary-crate or one-target shortcuts, so the dual pocket structure is not the thin route-tax tail rejected in v1. Independent evidence review and puzzle critic both returned required_action:none. Accepted score posture: difficulty 3+ and strong aesthetic 3 floor; critic did not support a 4 claim because the opening overshoot remains readable and fairly顺手. Evidence: prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/candidate_packet_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_OVERSHOOT_CUT_DUAL_POCKET_v2_review2.zh.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/evidence_review_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_OVERSHOOT_CUT_DUAL_POCKET_v2_review_2.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/puzzle_critic_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_OVERSHOOT_CUT_DUAL_POCKET_v2_review_2.md. 2026-07-08 human playtest set this candidate to reject with no additional comment text. Removed from playable and not entered as a clean archive record.

levels.title: Compact chain v1
levels.design_notes: review_2 提交候选。较低负担的紧凑双锚材料链：B/S 承担主要材料整理和左上 目标覆盖读法，返回解中 crate 跨 B/S 边界转 sticky，随后 sticky 刚体移动、 B/S 位移和 sticky_merge 形成短链；P/L 作为较轻但不可绕过的 pull 收束锚， 在返回解末段下移覆盖中线目标。完整事件组探针证明所有胜路都包含 P/L anchor shift、B/S anchor shift、pull、material normalization、sticky_merge 与 sticky rigid movement；不声明唯一路线、对象实例级必要性、逐目标覆盖身份、 所有胜路固定顺序或分数化审美/难度结论。 2026-07-04 human playtest rejected this candidate: some sticky cells are unused, and others become sticky without consuming sticky-specific structure beyond incidental adjacency. Discarded rather than archived.

levels.title: Brush triple output v2
levels.design_notes: Fresh lexicon-composition candidate based on `mechanism_lab/lexicon.md` only; `mechanism_lab/runs/` was not read. The player binds one C into an existing MM pair to make `MMM`, moves that footprint to a brush lane, then pushes the movable B/S boundary twice to produce `CCM`. The three resulting responsibilities are consumed as an upper C target, a lower C target, and a right-side sticky-tail target. Complete graph and probes show every win requires box_to_sticky, sticky_merge, sticky rigid movement, movable B/S boundary shift, and sticky_to_box; count probes show all wins require at least two B/S shifts, two sticky_to_box conversions, and two sticky rigid moves. Goal-prune checks retain all three targets: the top target is an all-win count gate rather than a shortest-cost gate, the lower target forces the second C output, and the right target consumes the remaining sticky tail. Independent evidence review and puzzle critic both returned required_action:none. Accepted score posture: difficulty 3 and strong aesthetic 3, not a 4+ claim. Evidence: prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/candidate_packet_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_BRUSH_TRIPLE_OUTPUT_v2_review1.zh.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/evidence_review_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_BRUSH_TRIPLE_OUTPUT_v2_review_1.md, prototypes/reality_anchor/reports/puzzle_critic_RA_LEX_2026_07_08_BRUSH_TRIPLE_OUTPUT_v2_review_1.md. 2026-07-08 human playtest flagged excessive redundant outer walls. Superseded by v3_outer_wall_trim, which crops only pure exterior wall columns and preserves the complete graph, shortest trace, and core probes.
